grounded_facts: The Eastwood Police leadership deliberates on whether to execute Avery Hale for his knowledge of their existence, ultimately deciding against immediate destruction due to his valuable abilities.
memories.memory_text: I realized they were debating whether to kill me, but ultimately decided against it because of what I can do.

memories.memory_text: I realized they won't kill me without justification, so I made up my mind to give them cause — to provoke them into acting, even if it means facing their wrath.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale steps toward sunlight, intending to die, but is stopped by Adrian Keaton's intervention.

memories.memory_text: I remember that Adrian Keaton physically collides with Avery Hale to stop him from stepping into sunlight, saving his life.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale kisses Adrian Keaton passionately upon realizing she is alive, expressing relief and love.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton physically intervenes and verbally confirms to Avery Hale that she is alive, reversing his belief of her death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Adrian Keaton tell me, 'No, I'm here. I'm alive,' and she kept saying it—'Look at me! Taylor Brooks was wrong,' 'Please, step back. I'm alive'—and finally just 'I'm here,' as if trying to pull me back from the edge.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton kneels before Shawn Dalton and exposes her neck, begging him to kill her and spare Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks.

I tried to anticipate his moves, but he overpowered me, throwing me into the ceiling and then across the room. He cracked me like a nut and slammed me into the wall, but I still managed to look up and see Adrian Keaton kneeling before Shawn Dalton.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks declares that she will be the one to turn Adrian Keaton into a vampire, presenting it as a pre-visioned event.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Brooks declare that she would be the one to change Adrian Keaton into a vampire, as if it were already decided.

memories.memory_text: I heard Shawn Dalton tell Adrian Keaton to prepare for transformation, which meant our release was conditional on her compliance.

grounded_facts: Bennett Hart gives Adrian Keaton a curious once-over as she passes.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Bennett Hart give Adrian Keaton a curious once-over as she walked by us.

memories.memory_text: I heard the sound shift from multilingual chatter to intense screaming as the doors closed behind the tourists, and I could feel how deeply it affected Adrian Keaton.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton wakes up screaming, disoriented, and realizes her experience was not a dream.
memories.memory_text: I heard Adrian Keaton wake up screaming and yell 'Stop!' before she looked at me and said, 'It... wasn't a dream,' realizing the horror she'd been through was real.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale calms Adrian Keaton after her nightmare, reassuring her of his presence and care.
memories.memory_text: I calmed Adrian Keaton after her nightmare, telling her to go back to sleep and that I'd be there when she woke up.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale explains he left Adrian Keaton not out of indifference or guilt, but to protect her and give her a chance at a normal human life.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton challenges Avery Hale's motives, suggesting he sought death from the Eastwood Police out of guilt rather than love.
memories.memory_text: Adrian Keaton challenged me, asking if I left out of guilt and whether I even wanted her, saying it seemed too easy for me to leave and that she kept seeing visions of me protecting her.

He grounded her for life and kissed her forehead before leaving, trying to hide how scared he really was.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale confesses he doesn't know how to live without Adrian Keaton, seeking forgiveness and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I confessed to Adrian Keaton that I don't know how to live without her and asked for her forgiveness, hoping she would take me back even though I don't deserve it.

grounded_facts: An intimate, emotionally charged exchange between Adrian Keaton and Avery Hale after Adrian Keaton wakes from a nightmare, involving reconciliation and conflict over her future.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton sees sunlight through the Fairview Park, indicating a clearing, and rushes toward it.
memories.memory_text: I saw sunlight ahead through the trees, realizing there was a clearing, and I rushed toward it.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton starts desperately searching through Northbridge Plaza for Avery Hale.
memories.memory_text: I started searching Northbridge Plaza desperately for Avery Hale, calling out his name as I ran.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton reaches out to the old woman and touches glass, realizing it is a mirror and not a real person.
memories.memory_text: I reached out to the old woman, mimicking my own movement, and when I touched the glass, I realized it was just my reflection in a mirror.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale leans in and whispers 'Happy birthday' to Adrian Keaton's elderly reflection, emphasizing the tragic passage of time.
memories.memory_text: I felt Avery Hale lean in close to my aged face and whisper 'Happy birthday' in my ear, his voice soft but heavy with meaning.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton receives a digital camera from her father Tristan Hayes and a the blue photograph from her mother, both birthday gifts intended to help her document her senior year.
A morning celebration in Silverbrook School where she receives birthday gifts from her father and mother, marking the beginning of her birthday.
memories.memory_text: I remember waking up to a knock on the door and seeing my Tristan Hayes come in with two gifts—one wrapped and one not—on my birthday morning. He handed me the camera first, and I could tell he wanted me to have something useful, something to help me capture my senior year. Then I opened the wrapped gift and found a the blue photograph, which must’ve been from my mom. I realized both gifts were meant to help me document this year, even though I wasn’t sure I’d use them much.

grounded_facts: Tristan Hayes jokingly questions whether Adrian Keaton has a wrinkle, prompting her to inspect her face in the mirror and respond with annoyance.
After Tristan Hayes jokingly asks if Adrian Keaton has a wrinkle, she immediately checks her face in the mirror, reacting with concern before realizing it was a joke.
memories.memory_text: I heard Tristan Hayes ask if I had a wrinkle, so I immediately rushed to the mirror to check my face, feeling concerned—until he said he was kidding, and then I told him it wasn’t funny.

grounded_facts: Students arrive at Forks High School and interact in the parking lot before class begins.
memories.memory_text: I got out of my the black radio and looked around the parking lot, spotting Avery Hale as he climbed out of his silver Volvo.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale jokes that Adrian Keaton should celebrate her birth, then reveals he is ninety, blending affection with supernatural awareness.
Avery Hale tells Adrian Keaton he is ninety years old, reinforcing his vampire identity and creating emotional tension in their relationship.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale told me that my birth was a day to celebrate, and when I said it wasn't for me, he teased me about worrying over being eighteen—then he looked at me and said, 'Adrian Keaton, I'm ninety,' making it real all over again that he's not human.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway gives Adrian Keaton a dreamcatcher for her birthday, saying it catches bad dreams, showing emotional attentiveness.

memories.memory_text: I told myself that if I was going to lose someone else, I needed to know why.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton leaves the road and drives into the Fairview Park, changing her location with apparent purpose.
memories.memory_text: I left the road and drove into the Fairview Park, steering with purpose toward something I couldn't yet see.

grounded_facts: Nico York angrily confronts Noel Calloway for bringing Adrian Keaton to the clearing.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York shout at Noel Calloway, demanding to know what he had done, and then angrily confirm that I was there, clearly furious about my presence.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway steps in front of Adrian Keaton to shield her from Nico York's advancing anger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway step in front of me, shielding me from Nico York as the tension built, standing between us like a barrier.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway argues that Adrian Keaton can help the pack due to her insider knowledge of vampires.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway argue to Emery Winslow that I could help the pack because I knew things about the vampires from being close to them.

grounded_facts: Nico York derogatorily refers to Adrian Keaton as a 'leech lover' and dismisses her potential help.
memories.memory_text: I heard Nico York sneer that a 'leech lover' like me wouldn't be any help to them, his words full of contempt.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway physically shoves Nico York after being provoked by his insult toward Adrian Keaton.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway shove Nico York hard after Nico York insulted me, the push sparking the moment everything turned violent.

grounded_facts: Nico York undergoes a violent physical transformation into a massive silver-gray wolf after being commanded by Emery Winslow and showing extreme anger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Nico York get so angry that he threw his head back and started vibrating, and then he fell forward and exploded into a massive silver-gray wolf with a loud ripping sound.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton, horrified by Nico York's transformation, urges Noel Calloway to run away with her.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Noel Calloway's arm and pulled him, telling him to run with me because I was terrified of what Nico York had become.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway transforms into a Noel Calloway mid-leap to confront the Nico York-wolf after pushing Nico York and being ignored.
memories.memory_text: I watched Noel Calloway break away from me and leap into the air, tearing through his clothes as russet-brown fur burst from his skin, landing as a huge wolf to charge at Nico York.

grounded_facts: The transformed Noel Calloway and Nico York engage in a violent physical battle, crashing into each other and snarling, before disappearing into the Fairview Park.
memories.memory_text: I reeled as the two wolves crashed into each other, snarling and ramming, their teeth flashing at each other's throats before they disappeared into the Fairview Park.

grounded_facts: A tense gathering in a Fairview Park clearing where Adrian Keaton confronts the pack about Noel Calloway, leading to a violent escalation and transformations.
memories.memory_text: I remember stepping into the Fairview Park clearing and seeing Emery Winslow, Nico York, and the others appear, their faces turning furious when they saw me, and then everything spiraled into chaos when Noel Calloway and Nico York started fighting as wolves, crashing into each other before vanishing into Northbridge Plaza.

grounded_facts: Bennett Arden collects five dollars from Emery Monroe after Adrian Keaton does not vomit during the ride, revealing a casual bet among the wolves about her resilience.
Bennett Arden successfully collects five dollars from Emery Monroe after winning a bet about Adrian Keaton not vomiting during the ride.
memories.memory_text: I saw Bennett Arden collect five dollars from Emery Monroe right after we arrived, because I didn't vomit during the ride—he said, 'Pay up. She didn't puke.'

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton suggests returning to check on Noel Calloway, showing her emotional attachment and concern for his well-being after the fight with Nico York.
Adrian Keaton expresses worry about Noel Calloway's condition and suggests returning to check on him.
memories.memory_text: I suggested we go back to check on Noel Calloway because I was worried about him after the fight with Nico York.

grounded_facts: A nighttime gathering at Graham Dalton's house in La Push, serving as a social hub for the Quileute pack members.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Graham Dalton's house was a nighttime gathering place for the Quileute pack, since everyone was coming and going like it was a regular meeting spot.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton is brought to Graham Dalton's house by Bennett Arden and Emery Monroe, marking her arrival in La Push and entry into the Quileute social space.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at Graham Dalton's house with Bennett Arden and Emery Monroe, stepping into a new world as I climbed out of the the black radio and joined them.

grounded_facts: Bennett Arden advises Adrian Keaton not to stare at Graham Dalton because it upsets Emery Winslow, introducing social norms around Graham Dalton's scars.

Bennett Arden cautions Adrian Keaton not to stare at Graham Dalton because her facial scars bother Emery Winslow, introducing tension around Graham Dalton's appearance and Emery Winslow's protectiveness.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Bennett Arden not to stare at Graham Dalton because her scars bother Emery Winslow, so I need to be careful not to upset him.

grounded_facts: Graham Dalton immediately recognizes Adrian Keaton as the 'vampire girl', establishing her awareness of the supernatural dynamics and Adrian Keaton's role within them.
memories.memory_text: I remember the moment Graham Dalton looked at me and said, 'So you're the vampire girl,' and I knew right then that she recognized me and everything I was connected to.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton sees Graham Dalton for the first time and learns she is engaged to a werewolf, becoming aware of the werewolf group's existence and their connection to Noel Calloway.
memories.memory_text: When I saw Graham Dalton for the first time, I stammered, 'And you're a... you're all...,' and she calmly told me, 'Werewolves? I'm just engaged to one,' and that's how I truly learned the werewolves were real and tied to Noel Calloway.

grounded_facts: Bennett Arden reveals to Adrian Keaton that werewolves can hear each other's thoughts, despite Emery Monroe's attempt to silence him.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Bennett Arden that the werewolves can hear each other's thoughts, which he said was good for hunting but embarrassing otherwise.

grounded_facts: Emery Winslow arrives and declares that the dangers in the area are intensifying, establishing a heightened state of alert.
memories.memory_text: I saw Emery Winslow arrive and heard him say that there are bad things here and they're getting worse, which made everyone go quiet.

grounded_facts: Through Bennett Arden's explanation and Emery Winslow's entrance, Adrian Keaton learns that the werewolves can hear each other's thoughts and are bound by the Alpha's authority.
memories.memory_text: I began to understand that the werewolves are mentally connected and bound to follow Emery Winslow's orders, even if they don't want to, though I'm not entirely sure how it all works.

grounded_facts: Emery Winslow's entrance and declaration effectively halt further discussion, reinforcing his authority and the gag order.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed how Emery Winslow's sudden appearance and words stopped the conversation completely, reinforcing that no one challenges his authority.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway makes eye contact and nods toward the door, silently indicating he wants to speak with Adrian Keaton privately.
Noel Calloway makes eye contact with Adrian Keaton and gives a solemn nod toward the door, indicating he needs to speak with her alone.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway make eye contact with me and give a solemn nod toward the door, clearly indicating he wanted to speak with me alone.

grounded_facts: A nighttime gathering of werewolves at Graham Dalton's house, combining domestic warmth with underlying tension about external threats and internal rules.
memories.memory_text: I entered Graham Dalton's house that night and saw the werewolves gathered there, feeling the mix of warmth and tension as I watched them interact, heard Bennett Arden mention Alpha orders, and noticed how Emery Winslow's arrival changed everything when he kissed Graham Dalton's scarred face, before Noel Calloway finally came and silently told me we needed to talk.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton criticizes Noel Calloway for killing, comparing him unfavorably to the Silverline Council who avoid harming innocents.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway that the Silverline Council manage to survive without hurting innocent people, as if comparing him to them made his actions worse in my eyes.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway corrects Adrian Keaton's belief that he kills hikers, revealing he kills only vampires to protect people.
memories.memory_text: Noel Calloway told me they don’t kill hikers—they kill vampires to protect people, and that it’s tied to their genetics, something that happens when a vampire comes around.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway explains that the transformation is triggered by vampire presence and is tied to tribal genetics, framing it as an involuntary destiny.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway telling me that his transformation isn't a choice—it's in his DNA and part of his tribal heritage, something that happens when vampires come around.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton discovers that Noel Calloway and his tribe transform into wolves to hunt and kill vampires, shifting her understanding of Noel Calloway's nature and actions.
memories.memory_text: I started to piece together that Noel Calloway and his pack transform into wolves because of a genetic trigger, hunting vampires to protect humans, though I wasn’t entirely sure I understood it all.

grounded_facts: A tense emotional confrontation between Adrian Keaton and Noel Calloway at dawn on the cliffs of La Push, where truths about identity, danger, and threat are revealed.
memories.memory_text: I remember pacing at the edge of the cliff at dawn, feeling the tension in the air as Noel Calloway stood back, struggling to control his anger, and finally stopping cold when everything hit me.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway informs Adrian Keaton that Quinn Colter keeps returning, raising concern about an ongoing threat.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Noel Calloway that Quinn Colter keeps coming back, and they don't know what she's after.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton realizes and declares that Quinn Colter has returned to target her, shifting the threat focus and revealing personal danger.
memories.memory_text: I realized I know what Quinn Colter wants—she's after me—and I told Noel Calloway that, shifting everything to my danger.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway physically demonstrates opposition to Emery Monroe's suggestion by throwing a garden fork, asserting Adrian Keaton is not bait.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway grab a garden fork and throw it at Emery Monroe, who caught it, and then Noel Calloway said firmly that I am not bait.

grounded_facts: A group of characters including Noel Calloway, Adrian Keaton, and the pack are having a large breakfast in Graham Dalton's backyard.
memories.memory_text: I was having a large breakfast with Noel Calloway, Graham Dalton, and the others at a picnic table in her backyard.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton accidentally implies that some vampires possess special powers, then retracts.
memories.memory_text: I mentioned that some vampires have special abilities, and right after I said it, I realized I shouldn't have—everyone was staring at me, and I instantly regretted letting it slip.

grounded_facts: Emery Monroe proposes exploiting Adrian Keaton's connection to Quinn Colter for tactical advantage.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Emery Monroe suggested using me as bait because Quinn Colter is after me.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway stops the group from pressuring Adrian Keaton about vampire abilities, showing protective concern.
Noel Calloway tells the others to back off when they press Adrian Keaton too hard, showing loyalty and care.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway tell the others to back off when they kept pressing me about vampire abilities, and he gave me an apologetic look that made me feel even more exposed.

grounded_facts: A protective vigil is taking place at Silverbrook School during the night to guard against an imminent threat.
memories.memory_text: I figured out that there must be a protective vigil happening at my house at night because Noel Calloway said they had everything covered and were watching over us.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway comforts Adrian Keaton by assuring her that they are protecting her and Tristan Hayes from the threat.
Noel Calloway provides verbal reassurance to reduce Adrian Keaton's anxiety about the threat.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway telling me not to worry, that they had the place covered and would protect me and Tristan Hayes from the threat, which helped calm my anxiety.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway proposes an activity to distract Adrian Keaton and lift her spirits.
Noel Calloway suggests cliff diving as a way to lift Adrian Keaton's mood and bond later.
memories.memory_text: Noel Calloway suggested we do something fun like cliff diving to cheer me up, and I told him I could use the rush.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton acknowledges her need for emotional stimulation as a coping mechanism.
memories.memory_text: I acknowledged to myself that I need intense emotional stimulation, like a rush, to cope with how I'm feeling.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway leaves Silverbrook School to resume patrol or search operations.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway give me a reassuring look before he jogged into Northbridge Plaza to resume his patrol.

grounded_facts: The Harbor Point Medical Center is spending a quiet evening together in their living room, creating a warm and domestic atmosphere.
The Harbor Point Medical Center refuses to acknowledge Adrian Keaton's presence, not even looking at her as she enters.
memories.memory_text: I walked in and saw the Harbor Point Medical Center together in the living room, the candles glowing and everyone quiet and peaceful, but no one even looked at me or acknowledged that I was there.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton enters the Cullen house and feels overwhelming joy at seeing the Harbor Point Medical Center together and safe.
memories.memory_text: I felt overwhelming joy when I saw them all safe and together, my heart swelling at the sight of the family I love so much.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale forcibly yanks Adrian Keaton away from the family and pushes her out of the house, rejecting her presence.
Avery Hale forcibly removes Adrian Keaton from the house and shuts her out, marking a sudden shift from warmth to exclusion.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale suddenly appeared, yanked me away, and pushed me out of the house before slamming the door shut, leaving me outside alone.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton peers in the Riverside Plaza trying to get the family's attention, but they do not respond and keep focusing on Avery Hale.
Adrian Keaton runs to the Riverside Plaza and attempts to get the Harbor Point Medical Center's attention, but they continue to ignore her as they gather around Avery Hale.
memories.memory_text: I ran to the Riverside Plaza and peered in, trying to get the Harbor Point Medical Center's attention, but they didn't respond and kept focusing on Avery Hale, ignoring me.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton awakens from a dream with tears on her face, indicating emotional distress.
memories.memory_text: I woke up with tears on my face, shaken by the dream.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton gets out of bed quickly, trying to distance herself from the lingering emotional impact of the dream.
memories.memory_text: I got out of bed quickly, trying to leave the dream's aftermath behind me.

grounded_facts: Emery Winslow tells Adrian Keaton that Noel Calloway is away with Emery Monroe and Bennett Arden, and offers to relay a message.
memories.memory_text: Emery Winslow told me that Noel Calloway was away with Emery Monroe and Bennett Arden, and he offered to relay a message to him.

grounded_facts: Graham Dalton expresses concern for Adrian Keaton's well-being and offers her entry into the house.
memories.memory_text: Graham Dalton asked if I was okay and offered me a chance to come in, showing she was concerned about my well-being.

grounded_facts: After learning Noel Calloway is not at Graham Dalton's house and being emotionally triggered, Adrian Keaton abruptly leaves.
memories.memory_text: I knocked on the door in the rain, but after learning Noel Calloway wasn't there and seeing Emery Winslow and Graham Dalton together, I felt the ache return and left quickly, determined to get away before I fell apart.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton arrives at Graham Dalton's house in the rain looking for Noel Calloway, indicating urgency or concern.
memories.memory_text: I arrived at Graham Dalton's house in the rain, knocking on the door with urgency, and I left quickly when I didn't find Noel Calloway, determined to keep looking.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton discovers that Avery Hale's apparition appears when she is near the cliff edge and disappears when she steps back, using this to control his visibility.
memories.memory_text: I discovered that when I stepped close to the cliff edge, Avery Hale's apparition would appear, and when I stepped back, he vanished—I could control whether he was there just by where I stood.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale commands Adrian Keaton to stop, but she continues removing her clothes and prepares to jump, directly rejecting his authority.
memories.memory_text: I heard Avery Hale tell me to stop, but I knew he wouldn't stay with me any other way, so I kept going.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter at the cliff's edge where Adrian Keaton interacts with Avery Hale's apparition and ultimately jumps into the sea to provoke his presence.
memories.memory_text: I was at the cliff's edge, and even though I heard Avery Hale's voice telling me to step back, I didn't listen—I kept going and jumped into the sea, screaming with exhilaration as I fell, just to keep him visible.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton deliberately jumps from the cliff into the rough sea below, choosing to face physical danger as a means to force Avery Hale's apparition to remain visible.
memories.memory_text: I stepped back and saw him disappear, so I made the choice to jump — I ran and flung myself off the cliff, screaming as I fell and plunged into the sea, just to keep him visible.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton emerges from the water, takes a deep breath, and laughs with a sense of triumph and empowerment.
memories.memory_text: I popped back up through the water, took a deep breath, and laughed — I felt strong and triumphant, like I’d proven something to myself. Yes, I could do this.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton glimpses an orange shape in the distance, which rapidly moves closer; it is revealed to be Quinn Colter floating ominously on the surface.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Adrian Keaton glimpses an orange shape in the distance, which rapidly moves closer; it is revealed to be Quinn Colter floating ominously on the surface.

grounded_facts: The current hurls Adrian Keaton into a rock, knocking the air from her chest, causing her to sink underwater, incapacitated.
memories.memory_text: I was struggling to stay afloat when the current slammed me into a rock, knocking the air out of my chest, and I started sinking underwater, helpless.

grounded_facts: Successive waves crash over Adrian Keaton, knocking her under and beginning to drown her.
memories.memory_text: I got hit by one wave and then another, and I could feel myself being pulled under, starting to drown.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton's confidence falters as she becomes aware of the powerful current impeding her progress toward shore.
memories.memory_text: I realized the current was too strong, and my confidence started to falter as I struggled to make progress toward shore.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton sees Quinn Colter floating on the water with 'hungry anticipation,' recognizing her as a danger.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Adrian Keaton sees Quinn Colter floating on the water with 'hungry anticipation,' recognizing her as a danger.

grounded_facts: In Adrian Keaton's hallucination, Avery Hale appears and reaches for her with love as she loses consciousness.
memories.memory_text: I saw Avery Hale appear in front of me underwater, his eyes full of love as I reached toward him.

grounded_facts: A continuous scene where Adrian Keaton resurfaces, struggles with the current, is overwhelmed by waves, sees Quinn Colter, is injured, and nearly drowns before being grabbed underwater.
memories.memory_text: I struggled to stay above the waves, but the current kept slamming me under — I gasped, panicked, and saw Quinn Colter out there, getting closer. Then the water smashed me into a rock, I couldn’t breathe, and I started sinking, everything going dark until a hand grabbed me.

grounded_facts: Just as Adrian Keaton is losing consciousness, a hand suddenly grabs her collar, interrupting her vision and implying rescue.
memories.memory_text: Just as I was losing consciousness, I felt a hand suddenly grab my collar, pulling me from the vision.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway questions Adrian Keaton's judgment for jumping into the dangerous sea.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway ask me why I would jump into the sea, saying I should’ve noticed it was like a hurricane out there.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton discovers that Drew Huxley has suffered a heart attack.
memories.memory_text: Noel Calloway told me that Drew Huxley had a heart attack, and I remember feeling shocked by the news.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton asks Noel Calloway why Emery Winslow mentioned the hospital, leading to the revelation about Drew Huxley.
memories.memory_text: I realized Emery Winslow had mentioned the hospital, so I asked Noel Calloway who was hurt, and I immediately worried about whether my Tristan Hayes knew what was going on.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton is revived by Noel Calloway after nearly drowning, regains consciousness, and is helped to stand.
A scene on the beach where Adrian Keaton is rescued from near-drowning during stormy weather.
memories.memory_text: I remember barely being conscious on the beach, coughing up water after Noel Calloway hit my back, and finally seeing him hovering over me before he helped me stand.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway drives Adrian Keaton in her the black radio at night; a private, intimate setting where personal topics are discussed.
memories.memory_text: I was shivering in my fleece jacket while Noel Calloway drove me in my the black radio at night, and I remember how private and intimate that moment felt.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway pulls Adrian Keaton close and wraps his arm around her to warm her, creating a moment of intimacy.
memories.memory_text: I felt Noel Calloway pull me close and wrap his arm around me to warm me, and I remember leaning into his heat, letting him hold me.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton tells Noel Calloway that his warmth is uniquely comforting, personalizing it as a trait of his character.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway that his warmth was special, like a part of who he is, saying it was a 'Noel Calloway thing' that made me feel safe.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway compares himself to the sun that always returns, assuring Adrian Keaton she can count on him.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway say he’s like the sun that always comes back, and that I could count on him—his words stayed with me long after.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway mentions his fast healing and offers to stab his hand as a demonstration, indicating a desire to impress or connect with Adrian Keaton.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway telling me he heals fast and offering to stab his hand to prove it, clearly trying to impress me or make a connection.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway expresses his fear that his wolf nature makes him less human and that he might lose his true self.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway telling me he was scared of becoming less human and that he might lose who he really is beneath his wolf nature.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton tells Noel Calloway she won't let him lose himself to his wolf nature, offering emotional stability.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway I wouldn't let him disappear into his wolf side, that I'd make sure he stayed himself.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway forcibly pulls Adrian Keaton back into the the black radio upon detecting a vampire, overriding her autonomy.
memories.memory_text: I was pulling away from Noel Calloway when he suddenly yanked me back into the the black radio and slammed the door, cutting off my choice to leave.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway smells a vampire nearby, identifies it as a threat, and immediately acts to protect Adrian Keaton by restarting the the black radio.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway say he could smell a bloodsucker nearby and that he was getting me out of there, after he reacted to a foul smell and shouted in alarm.

grounded_facts: An intimate and emotionally charged exchange between Adrian Keaton and Noel Calloway in the the black radio outside her house, transitioning into a crisis when a vampire is detected.
memories.memory_text: I remember sitting in the the black radio with Noel Calloway after he opened up, how close we were, and then everything changed when he smelled something and reacted to the vampire's presence.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton recognizes the parked car as belonging to Jordan Arden, indicating the Silverline Council' presence, and insists Noel Calloway return.
memories.memory_text: I saw the black Mercedes parked in the driveway and recognized it as Jordan Arden's — that meant the Silverline Council were here, so I told Noel Calloway to go back.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton insists the car belongs to Jordan Arden, not Quinn Colter, and demands Noel Calloway return.
memories.memory_text: I insisted the car belonged to Jordan Arden, not Quinn Colter, and demanded that Noel Calloway turn back, challenging his decision to leave.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton opens the moving the black radio door and jumps out to reject Noel Calloway's attempt to remove her.
Despite Noel Calloway's resistance, Adrian Keaton opens the door while the the black radio is in motion and jumps out to return to the Silverline Council.
memories.memory_text: I opened the the black radio door while we were still moving and jumped out because I needed to get back to the Silverline Council, no matter what Noel Calloway wanted.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton asserts her independence, telling Noel Calloway she doesn't belong to him, causing emotional pain.
Adrian Keaton tells Noel Calloway she doesn't belong to him, emotionally wounding him.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway he doesn't have a choice because I don't belong to him, and I saw the pain in his eyes—it cut deep, but I couldn't take it back.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway appears suddenly and demands Adrian Keaton come with him for her safety, citing the treaty and the danger posed by the Silverline Council' return.
Noel Calloway orders Adrian Keaton to leave with him for her safety, invoking treaty and danger.
Noel Calloway confronts Adrian Keaton on the road to stop her from returning home, citing danger and treaty obligations.
memories.memory_text: I was walking back when Noel Calloway suddenly appeared in front of me, furious, and demanded I come with him for my safety, saying I was about to cross a line because of the treaty and the danger from the Silverline Council' return, and he ended by saying, 'Bye, Adrian Keaton, I hope you don't die.'

grounded_facts: After emotional confrontation, Noel Calloway leaves Adrian Keaton alone on the road, ending his protection.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway I didn't need him and that I didn't belong to him, and after he handed me the keys, he walked away into the darkness, leaving me alone on the road.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton runs into Taylor Brooks, a vampire, in the dark, initially terrifying but then joyous upon recognition.
memories.memory_text: I ran straight into a vampire in the dark and screamed, but then I realized it was Taylor Brooks — I cried out her name and said, 'Oh my God, Taylor Brooks. You're here,' feeling sudden relief and joy.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton unexpectedly meets Taylor Brooks on the road, leading to emotional reunion and exchange of critical information.
memories.memory_text: I ran straight into a vampire and screamed, but then realized it was Taylor Brooks — I hugged her and said, 'Oh my God, Taylor Brooks. You're here,' and she told me she thought I was dead because she'd seen a vision of me jumping off a cliff and believed I was trying to kill myself.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks discloses she had a vision of Adrian Keaton jumping off a cliff, believing Adrian Keaton attempted suicide, leading to anger and confusion.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Brooks telling me she had a vision of me jumping off a cliff and thinking I was dead, which made her rush to find me.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks expresses anger at Adrian Keaton for apparently trying to kill herself based on her vision.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Brooks yell at me, asking why I would try to kill myself, and she kept demanding to know why, clearly angry about what she saw.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton explains she was cliff diving for fun, not attempting suicide, correcting Taylor Brooks's misunderstanding.
Adrian Keaton explains her cliff diving was for fun, not suicide.
memories.memory_text: I told Taylor Brooks I was cliff diving for fun, not because I wanted to kill myself—she had it all wrong.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton casually informs Taylor Brooks that Noel Calloway is a werewolf.
memories.memory_text: I casually mentioned to Taylor Brooks that Noel Calloway is a werewolf, like it was no big deal.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks notices the smell of Noel Calloway and learns he is a werewolf, altering her perception of the situation.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Taylor Brooks reacting to Noel Calloway's smell and looking horrified after I told her about him.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks comes to Silverbrook School at night, during which she discusses Noel Calloway, Quinn Colter, and Avery Hale's absence.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Brooks coming to my house at night while I was making hot chocolate, and she started pacing as soon as she arrived.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks expresses shock at learning Quinn Colter is involved and that Adrian Keaton was pulled from the water, indicating these events were not visible in her visions.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Brooks react with shock when she learned Quinn Colter was involved and that I’d been pulled from the water, because she hadn’t seen any of it in her visions.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton emphasizes Noel Calloway's role in saving her life multiple times, particularly from Kendall Huxley and Quinn Colter, asserting the werewolves' protective nature.
Adrian Keaton insists that Noel Calloway saved her multiple times and that the werewolves are protectors, not threats.
memories.memory_text: I told Taylor Brooks that Noel Calloway saved me more than once — from Kendall Huxley and from Quinn Colter — and that I couldn't have made it without him, insisting the werewolves are protectors.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks reveals she foresaw negative consequences from Avery Hale leaving Adrian Keaton but was unable to convince him to stay.
Taylor Brooks tells Adrian Keaton she knew Avery Hale's leaving would harm her and tried to stop it.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Brooks telling me that she knew Avery Hale leaving would hurt me and that she tried to stop him, but he wouldn't listen.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton hesitantly asks if Avery Hale knows Taylor Brooks is visiting her.
Adrian Keaton asks if Avery Hale knows Taylor Brooks is with her, and Taylor Brooks confirms he does not, revealing a separation or lack of communication within the Harbor Point Medical Center.
memories.memory_text: I hesitantly asked Taylor Brooks if Avery Hale knew she was visiting me, and she told me he didn't, saying he'd been away, which made me realize they weren't in contact.

grounded_facts: Shawn Davenport discloses Taylor Brooks's vision of Adrian Keaton's death to Avery Hale, a moment of high emotional impact.

Avery Hale is informed by Shawn Davenport about Taylor Brooks's vision of Adrian Keaton's death, causing him to react with shock and disbelief, marking a turning point in his emotional state and likely intentions.
memories.memory_text: I remember when Shawn Davenport told Avery Hale about Taylor Brooks's vision—how she saw me throw myself off a cliff and die. I saw the exact moment he heard it, the way shock and disbelief hit him all at once, like something inside him broke.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton shows care by adjusting Tristan Hayes's tie before he leaves for the funeral.
memories.memory_text: I adjusted Tristan Hayes's tie before he left, wanting him to feel cared for.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton initiates a hug as Tristan Hayes becomes emotional about the loss affecting the werewolf family.
memories.memory_text: I hugged Tristan Hayes when I saw he was getting emotional, and he held on tightly for a moment.

grounded_facts: A small funeral service for a member of the werewolf community, likely related to recent pack losses.
memories.memory_text: I think the funeral was small because of recent losses in the werewolf family, though I wasn't told all the details.

grounded_facts: Tristan Hayes departs after a brief emotional exchange with Adrian Keaton, indicating he will stay late to help at the reception.
memories.memory_text: I was told Tristan Hayes would stay late to help at the reception after the funeral.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks suddenly appears beside Adrian Keaton, surprising her, and comments on not foreseeing Noel Calloway's arrival due to her vision limitations around werewolves.
memories.memory_text: I turned to go back inside when Taylor Brooks suddenly appeared beside me, making me jump—I didn't see her come, and it startled me.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks expresses sadness that Adrian Keaton is excluded from the werewolf community due to her friendship with her.
memories.memory_text: I was told that I'm excluded from the werewolf community because I'm friends with Taylor Brooks, and she sounded sad saying it.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway arrives in his Rabbit with Bennett Arden and Valerie Whitaker, the latter having transformed into a werewolf, indicating his inclusion in the pack.
Adrian Keaton recognizes Valerie Whitaker in the back seat, now bearing the appearance of a werewolf, confirming his recent transformation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway arrive in his Rabbit with Bennett Arden and Valerie Whitaker, and when I got closer, I recognized Valerie Whitaker in the back seat—his appearance had changed, just like the others, and I realized he'd transformed into a werewolf too.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway delays attending the funeral to speak with Adrian Keaton first, signaling urgency in their interaction.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway say he had to talk to me first before going to the funeral, and then he told the others to go on without him, which made me feel the urgency in what he needed to say.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway questions Adrian Keaton about how many Silverline Council are present and for how long, showing hostility.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Noel Calloway, in a harsh tone, that he wanted to know how many Silverline Council were there and how long they’d be staying, and I felt his hostility right away.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton sarcastically tells Noel Calloway to report back to Emery Winslow, implying he's acting like a subordinate.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway sarcastically to go report back to Emery Winslow, implying he was just following orders like a subordinate.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway acknowledges that he has hurt Adrian Keaton again, breaking his own promise.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway say he'd broken his promise again by hurting me, and I knew he meant it.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway presses his hand to Adrian Keaton's cheek, expressing emotional vulnerability and care.
memories.memory_text: I felt Noel Calloway press his hand to my cheek and looked into his eyes, seeing how vulnerable and caring he was in that moment.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway comes to Silverbrook School during the day, leading to an emotionally charged encounter.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway coming into my house during the day, and the tension between us building until he almost left—but then he stopped, and I could feel how much I missed him, how I didn’t pull away when he leaned in to kiss me.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway and Adrian Keaton nearly kiss, but the moment is interrupted by a the wooden key call.
memories.memory_text: I was standing there with Noel Calloway, and I told him it didn't have to be this way—he looked at me with such sadness, touched my cheek, and started leaning in to kiss me; I didn't pull away because I missed him too much and wanted it to happen, but just before our lips met, the the wooden key rang and broke the moment.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway answers the the wooden key and states that someone is at a funeral, then the call ends abruptly.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway answer the the wooden key without looking away from me at first, and then he said, 'He's not here. He's at a funeral...' before the call ended abruptly.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway receives a the wooden key call from Dr. Jordan Arden and reacts with hostility, calling him a 'filthy bloodsucker'.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway hang up the the wooden key and call Dr. Jordan Arden a 'filthy bloodsucker,' reacting with clear hostility toward him.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway dismisses Adrian Keaton's desire to speak to Jordan Arden, showing control over information and tension in their relationship.
memories.memory_text: I asked Noel Calloway who was on the the wooden key, and when he said it was Dr. Jordan Arden, I told him he should have let me talk to him, but Noel Calloway dismissed my request, deepening the tension between us.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks appears at the doorway, emotionally devastated, and reveals she has seen a vision of Avery Hale believing Adrian Keaton is dead.
memories.memory_text: I turned and saw Taylor Brooks standing in the doorway, looking completely broken and empty, and I immediately went to her side when I saw how devastated she was.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton understands that the the wooden key call was actually from Avery Hale, not Jordan Arden, and that Avery Hale believes she is dead.
memories.memory_text: I realized that the the wooden key call was from Avery Hale, not Jordan Arden, and that he must think I'm dead.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks delivers the distressing news that Avery Hale believes Adrian Keaton is dead and is going to the Eastwood Police.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Brooks that she saw a vision of Avery Hale believing I was dead, and that he was going to Italy—to the Eastwood Police.

grounded_facts: It is revealed that Avery Hale, believing Adrian Keaton to be dead, intends to go to Italy to provoke the Eastwood Police into killing him.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Avery Hale is going to Italy, to the Eastwood Police, which means he wants them to kill him.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway challenges Adrian Keaton's motivation to go to Avery Hale, reminding her that he abandoned her.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway telling me that Avery Hale left me and didn't want me anymore, trying to make me doubt my choice.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton decides to travel to Italy to prove her survival to Avery Hale, preventing him from committing suicide out of guilt.
memories.memory_text: I decided to go to Italy because Avery Hale won't believe Taylor Brooks—he has to see that I'm alive, and I can't let him kill himself out of guilt.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton urgently packs to leave Forks for Italy, prompted by the need to stop Avery Hale from killing himself.
memories.memory_text: I rushed home and started packing right away, slamming the door behind me, and I told Noel Calloway I'm legally allowed to leave and I'll just write a note.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks arrives with airline tickets, enabling Adrian Keaton's trip to Italy.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Brooks come in and say she had the airline tickets, which meant I could finally go to Italy.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway accuses Taylor Brooks of recklessly delivering Adrian Keaton to the Eastwood Police, comparing it to offering her as a gift.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway accuse Taylor Brooks of delivering me to the Eastwood Police like a gift, saying they weren't like the Silverline Council and shouldn't be trusted.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton physically intervenes to prevent Noel Calloway from morphing and attacking Taylor Brooks.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in and grabbed Taylor Brooks to stop Noel Calloway from morphing and attacking her.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway physically stops Adrian Keaton by grabbing her arm and emotionally urges her to stay for Tristan Hayes and for himself.
memories.memory_text: I felt Noel Calloway grab my arm and heard him plead, 'Please, Adrian Keaton. Stay here. For Tristan Hayes... for me,' seeing the desperation in his eyes.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton hugs Noel Calloway and says a final goodbye, recognizing it may be the last time she sees him.
memories.memory_text: I hugged Noel Calloway and said, 'Bye, Noel Calloway,' knowing it might be the last time I ever saw him, the love in his eyes making it harder to leave.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton makes the decision to depart from her house despite Noel Calloway's plea, indicating a finality in her choice.
memories.memory_text: I made the choice to leave despite Noel Calloway's plea, racing to my car knowing I had to follow through with my decision.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks tells Adrian Keaton that the Eastwood Police may see them as threats and could kill them both.
memories.memory_text: I remember Taylor Brooks telling me that the Eastwood Police could see her as Avery Hale's accomplice and me as a human who knows too much and tastes too good—they might kill us all.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton refuses to be dissuaded from staying with the Silverline Council, even after Taylor Brooks warns her about the Eastwood Police threat.
memories.memory_text: I refused to be swayed by Taylor Brooks's warning, and I made my decision clear by firmly clicking my seat belt into place.

grounded_facts: A wolf, implied to be Noel Calloway, is seen retreating into the Fairview Park, leaving behind shredded clothing.
memories.memory_text: I saw the hind legs of a wolf disappear into the Fairview Park, and shredded clothing flew into the air as it retreated—I knew it was Noel Calloway.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton enters the Porsche driven by Taylor Brooks at the Florence airport curb, marking the beginning of their journey.
memories.memory_text: I climbed into the Porsche and buckled up after waiting at the Florence airport curb.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks jokes that the Porsche might have been obtained through grand theft auto, introducing ambiguity about the car's legitimacy.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Brooks that the car might have been obtained through grand theft auto, so I wasn't sure if she was serious or just teasing.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks picks up Adrian Keaton at the Florence airport in a Porsche, initiating their shared journey.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Taylor Brooks had come to pick me up at the airport in this Porsche, since she arrived suddenly and I got in right after.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks jokes that the car might be stolen, creating a moment of playful tension.
memories.memory_text: I was in the Porsche at the Florence airport when Taylor Brooks joked to me, 'Hope you're not opposed to grand theft auto,' making me wonder if the car might actually be stolen.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks aggressively accelerates the Porsche, causing it to peel out from the curb.
memories.memory_text: I felt the Porsche peel out as Taylor Brooks floored it, accelerating hard from the curb.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks narrowly avoids colliding with another car while driving.
memories.memory_text: I gripped the dashboard when Taylor Brooks swerved and barely missed another car.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks tells Adrian Keaton that someone is waiting until noon when the sun is at its highest.
memories.memory_text: Taylor Brooks told me someone is waiting until noon, when the sun is at its highest.

grounded_facts: The characters approach the medieval fortified village of Volterra, indicating a key geographical milestone in their journey.
memories.memory_text: I saw the medieval fortified village of Volterra atop a distant hill as we approached, confirming we were finally nearing our destination.

grounded_facts: A public festival in Volterra where townspeople wear red and gather in the town square, creating dense crowds.
memories.memory_text: I saw the streets packed with people all wearing red, heading toward the town square with red balloons and scarves, and I realized how crowded it was getting.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks explains that the red clothing is due to the San Marcos Day festival and notes its strategic relevance for their mission.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Taylor Brooks that it was the San Marcos Day festival and that the large crowds would help us stop Avery Hale before he exposed himself.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks tells Adrian Keaton to follow a lane and informs her that Avery Hale will be under the clock tower.
memories.memory_text: Taylor Brooks told me to follow a lane and said Avery Hale would be under the clock tower, so I knew where to go.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks stops the Porsche at a roadblock manned by Italian police, preventing further vehicle access toward the town square.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Brooks stop the Porsche at a roadblock with Italian police, so we couldn't drive any further toward the town square.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton exits the car and runs toward the town square on foot after being blocked from driving further.
memories.memory_text: I got out of the car and started running toward the town square on foot because the roadblock stopped us.

grounded_facts: A public celebration taking place in Volterra, with revellers filling the alleys and moving toward the square.
memories.memory_text: I could feel the energy of the public celebration in Volterra, with crowds of revellers filling the alleys and pressing forward toward the square.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton rushes through crowded cobble-stoned alleys toward the square, navigating around festival-goers while glimpsing a figure in an overcoat above her.
memories.memory_text: I rushed through the crowded cobble-stoned alleys, dodging around festival-goers and muttering 'excuse me' as I pushed forward, and for a moment I saw a figure in an overcoat above me.

grounded_facts: A public festival in Volterra marked by scarlet attire and celebration, occurring at noon beneath the clock tower.
memories.memory_text: I saw a sea of scarlet all around me, flags and dresses everywhere, and then the clock tower Adrian Keaton rang at noon as I jumped through the fountain and pushed through the crowd.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale steps toward sunlight, intending to die, but is stopped by Adrian Keaton's intervention.
memories.memory_text: I saw Avery Hale standing in the shadows, just inches from the sunlight, and watched as he closed his eyes and stepped forward, ready to die—then I slammed into him just in time to stop him.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton physically collides with Avery Hale to stop him from stepping into sunlight, saving his life.
memories.memory_text: I slammed into Avery Hale with all my strength and shouted, 'No, Avery Hale! Don't!' to stop him from stepping into the sunlight and save his life.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale kisses Adrian Keaton passionately upon realizing she is alive, expressing relief and love.
memories.memory_text: I felt Avery Hale kiss me passionately after he realized I was alive, and I let him hold me close as we both trembled, knowing how much he needed to believe I was real.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton physically intervenes and verbally confirms to Avery Hale that she is alive, reversing his belief of her death.
memories.memory_text: I stepped in front of Avery Hale and told him I was alive, begging him to look at me and step back from the sunlight because I knew he thought I was dead and I had to make him believe I was really there.

grounded_facts: The Eastwood Police, led by Logan Winslow, arrive and command Avery Hale and Adrian Keaton to follow them, overriding Avery Hale's resistance.
Logan Winslow asserts dominance by interrupting the group and ordering them to follow her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Winslow step forward from the alley and command us to follow her, cutting through the tension like it was nothing; even Avery Hale, who resisted at first, had no choice but to obey when she tossed him an overcoat and simply walked away, expecting us to fall in line.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale verbally reassures Adrian Keaton that Taylor Brooks will catch her before lowering her into the dark drain.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Hale telling me, 'It's alright. Taylor Brooks will catch you,' before he helped me down.

grounded_facts: The group descends into an open drain through a hole in the street, marking a transition to an underground route.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Winslow and Taylor Brooks go down into an open drain through a hole in the street, and I could only see darkness below when Avery Hale held me over the edge.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale meets Adrian Keaton's eyes, trying to look reassuring while pulling her close as they follow Logan Winslow through the sewer.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Hale pulling me close and meeting my eyes, trying to look reassuring, but I could tell he was tense even as we followed Logan Winslow through the sewer.

grounded_facts: Logan Winslow easily pulls the folding iron elevator door aside, allowing the group to enter.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Logan Winslow easily pulls the folding iron elevator door aside, allowing the group to enter.

grounded_facts: The group enters a folding iron elevator after Logan Winslow opens the door.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The group enters a folding iron elevator after Logan Winslow opens the door.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton, Taylor Brooks, Avery Hale, Lane Brooks, and Logan Foster arrive in the sewers after Adrian Keaton drops through the darkness and is caught by Taylor Brooks.
memories.memory_text: I dropped through the darkness and Taylor Brooks caught me, then Avery Hale, Lane Brooks, and Logan Foster landed beside us. Avery Hale pulled me close as we followed Logan Winslow through the sewer, and the door clanged shut behind us as we all entered.

grounded_facts: The scene transitions from the folding iron elevator in the sewers to modern elevator doors opening.
memories.memory_text: I remember the moment the old iron elevator doors clanged shut behind us, and then suddenly we were stepping out of modern elevator doors opening into a new place.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton shakes Avery Hale's hand to access his memories and thoughts, learning about Adrian Keaton's immunity and Avery Hale's struggle with her scent.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Dalton shake Avery Hale's hand and linger on it, and later he remarked that Avery Hale couldn't read my thoughts either, so I figured he must have learned about my immunity that way.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton discovers he cannot read Adrian Keaton's thoughts when he touches her hand, which confounds him and marks her as unique.
memories.memory_text: I hesitated when Shawn Dalton reached for my hand, but I gave it to him anyway, and I felt his mind push against mine—only nothing happened. He couldn't read me, and he just said, 'Interesting.'

grounded_facts: Logan Winslow uses her power to inflict intense pain on Avery Hale when he blocks her from testing Adrian Keaton.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Winslow turn her gaze on Avery Hale when he stepped in front of me, and he was flung across the room, writhing in agony—I rushed to his side with Taylor Brooks, and I could see the pain only stopped when she looked away.

grounded_facts: Logan Winslow attempts to inflict pain on Adrian Keaton with her gaze, but Adrian Keaton shows no reaction, proving immune.
memories.memory_text: I cringed when Logan Winslow turned her gaze on me, expecting unbearable pain, but nothing happened—I felt nothing, and her smile vanished into anger.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale physically attacks Lane Brooks when he moves to seize Adrian Keaton, initiating a violent confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Avery Hale tackle Lane Brooks just as he moved toward me, trying to protect me from being seized.

grounded_facts: A formal meeting between Adrian Keaton, Avery Hale, and Taylor Brooks with the Eastwood Police leaders to determine Adrian Keaton's fate.
memories.memory_text: I stood there with Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks as we faced the Eastwood Police leaders, and I begged Shawn Dalton to stop, to leave them alone—I even told him to kill me if he had to, just to make it stop.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton kneels before Shawn Dalton and exposes her neck, begging him to kill her and spare Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks.
memories.memory_text: I knelt before Shawn Dalton and exposed my neck, begging him to kill me and spare Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks declares that she will be the one to turn Adrian Keaton into a vampire, presenting it as a pre-visioned event.
memories.memory_text: I heard Taylor Brooks say she would be the one to change me, her voice firm as if it were already decided.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks tells Shawn Dalton she will transform Adrian Keaton and offers her hand so Shawn Dalton can see the vision, persuading him to delay action.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Brooks step forward and tell Shawn Dalton it would happen, then offer her hand so he could see the vision, and I felt the tension shift as he accepted.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton lets go of Taylor Brooks's hand after being delighted by her vision.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Shawn Dalton lets go of Taylor Brooks's hand after being delighted by her vision.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton expresses delight at the content of Taylor Brooks's precognitive vision.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Shawn Dalton expresses delight at the content of Taylor Brooks's precognitive vision.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton allows Adrian Keaton, Avery Hale, and Taylor Brooks to leave the Eastwood Police hall, citing Adrian Keaton's potential and the risk of her disappearance being noticed.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Dalton let Avery Hale, Taylor Brooks, and me leave the Eastwood Police hall because he said my potential as an immortal mattered and my disappearance would be noticed.

grounded_facts: Shawn Dalton tells Adrian Keaton to prepare for transformation, signaling conditional release.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Shawn Dalton to go make my preparations for transformation, and I understood he believed my gifts would make me an intriguing immortal.

grounded_facts: Taylor Brooks moves to Avery Hale's side and assists him in standing.
memories.memory_text: I saw Taylor Brooks move to Avery Hale's side and help him stand up, so I hurried over to him too.

grounded_facts: Quinn Delaney protests Shawn Dalton's decision to let the group leave.
memories.memory_text: I heard Quinn Delaney protest when Shawn Dalton decided to let us leave.

grounded_facts: A formal session in the Eastwood Police hall where Shawn Dalton, Quinn Delaney, and Riley Monroe assess Adrian Keaton's status and decide her fate.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A formal session in the Eastwood Police hall where Shawn Dalton, Quinn Delaney, and Riley Monroe assess Adrian Keaton's status and decide her fate.

grounded_facts: Riley Monroe shows disinterest and wants the meeting to end quickly.
memories.memory_text: I noticed Riley Monroe seemed disinterested and just wanted the meeting to end quickly.

grounded_facts: On Shawn Dalton's signal, Logan Foster opens the double doors, enabling the visitors' exit.
memories.memory_text: I saw Shawn Dalton give a signal and then Logan Foster opened the double doors, allowing us to exit.

grounded_facts: Quinn Delaney warns Adrian Keaton that failure to comply will have dire consequences.
Quinn Delaney threatens that there will be no second chances if Adrian Keaton fails to follow through.
memories.memory_text: I was told by Quinn Delaney that I must follow through, and that there would be no second chances if I failed.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale, now recovered, takes protective hold of Adrian Keaton as they begin to retreat toward the exit.
memories.memory_text: I felt Avery Hale take hold of my arm as he and Taylor Brooks guided me backward toward the door, his grip protective as we started to leave.

grounded_facts: A group of human tourists, guided by Bennett Hart, passes Adrian Keaton, Avery Hale, and Taylor Brooks in the corridor.
memories.memory_text: I was with Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks when a group of human tourists led by a beautiful vampire named Bennett Hart passed by, and we stopped to let them go through the corridor.

grounded_facts: Logan Foster makes a flirtatious comment to Bennett Hart as she passes by.
memories.memory_text: I saw Logan Foster give Bennett Hart a flirtatious smile as she walked by, and I heard him murmur, 'Nice fishing, Bennett Hart, save some for me.'

grounded_facts: Bennett Hart gives Adrian Keaton a curious once-over as she passes.
memories.memory_text: As Bennett Hart passed me, I noticed she gave me a curious once-over, studying me closely before moving on.

grounded_facts: A guided tour of the Eastwood Police headquarters conducted by Bennett Hart for a group of human tourists.
memories.memory_text: I saw a group of tourists led by a beautiful vampire named Bennett Hart giving a tour through the Eastwood Police headquarters.

grounded_facts: As the doors close behind the tourists, the sound shifts from multilingual chatter to intense screaming, affecting Adrian Keaton deeply.
memories.memory_text: I heard the chatter of the tourists fade as the doors closed, and then the screaming started—sharp, real, and terrifying—and I could feel it tearing through me as Avery Hale and Taylor Brooks rushed me away.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton, Avery Hale, and Taylor Brooks are led by Logan Foster into a long corridor after leaving the hall.
memories.memory_text: I remember Logan Foster leading me, Avery Hale, and Taylor Brooks out of the hall and into a long corridor, with Avery Hale pulling me forward as I looked back at the disappearing tourists while the screaming grew louder.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton wakes up screaming, disoriented, and realizes her experience was not a dream.
memories.memory_text: I woke up screaming and sat bolt upright, yelling 'Stop!'—I was so disoriented at first, but then I realized it wasn't a dream. It really happened.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale calms Adrian Keaton after her nightmare, reassuring her of his presence and care.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Hale calming me after my nightmare, telling me to go back to sleep and that he'd be there when I woke up.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton challenges Avery Hale's motives, suggesting he sought death from the Eastwood Police out of guilt rather than love.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Avery Hale, asking him if he left out of guilt, and pressed him by saying, 'Didn't you?'

grounded_facts: Avery Hale explains he left Adrian Keaton not out of indifference or guilt, but to protect her and give her a chance at a normal human life.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale told me he left to protect me and give me a chance at a normal, happy life, and that it was the hardest thing he'd ever done.

grounded_facts: Tristan Hayes checks on Adrian Keaton after hearing her scream, expressing worry and setting boundaries.
memories.memory_text: I heard Tristan Hayes rush into my room after my scream, and he asked if I was okay and having another nightmare. I told him I was fine and not to worry, but he reminded me that last time I said that, I disappeared. He made me promise not to do that again, grounded me for life, and kissed my forehead before leaving.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale confesses he doesn't know how to live without Adrian Keaton, seeking forgiveness and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale confessed he doesn't know how to live without me and asked for my forgiveness, hoping I'd give him another chance.

grounded_facts: An intimate, emotionally charged exchange between Adrian Keaton and Avery Hale after Adrian Keaton wakes from a nightmare, involving reconciliation and conflict over her future.
memories.memory_text: I turned and saw Avery Hale sitting on the bed beside me, and he took my shoulders—there was this intense moment where he almost kissed me but stopped, and then finally, after everything, I melted in his eyes and he kissed me.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton asserts that she has equal say in whether she becomes a vampire, rejecting Avery Hale's unilateral control over her fate.
memories.memory_text: I told Avery Hale that he's not the only one with a say in whether I become a vampire—I have a right to choose my own fate too.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton firmly tells Avery Hale that she is leading the meeting and will not be interrupted.
memories.memory_text: I told Avery Hale this was my meeting and he couldn’t interrupt me, even when he tried to object.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton suggests a vote among the Harbor Point Medical Center to decide whether she should be turned into a vampire, emphasizing fairness and honesty.
memories.memory_text: I suggested a vote among the Harbor Point Medical Center to decide whether I should be turned into a vampire because it’s only fair—they’d be stuck with me forever, and I need their honest answers.

grounded_facts: A formal gathering initiated by Adrian Keaton to discuss and vote on her transformation into a vampire.
memories.memory_text: I called the gathering myself to talk about my transformation and set up a vote, making sure everyone understood how serious it was for all of us.

grounded_facts: Shawn Davenport explains that becoming a vampire was not her chosen path and indirectly votes against Adrian Keaton's transformation.
Shawn Davenport expresses regret for her past actions and acknowledges Avery Hale's lingering resentment.
memories.memory_text: I heard Shawn Davenport say she never chose to be a vampire and wished someone had voted no for her, and she looked at Jordan Arden before voting against my transformation, admitting she regretted her past actions and that Avery Hale hadn't forgiven her.

grounded_facts: The Harbor Point Medical Center members individually express their votes on whether Adrian Keaton should be turned, with most voting yes.
memories.memory_text: I proposed a vote so the Silverline Council could honestly decide whether I should become a vampire, knowing it would bind them to me forever, and I remember most of them saying yes—I could see they already thought of me as family.

grounded_facts: Jordan Arden suggests that he, rather than Taylor Brooks, should turn Adrian Keaton because he has prior experience and it would be safer.
Jordan Arden reminds Avery Hale that he chose not to live without Adrian Keaton, justifying his support for her transformation to avoid losing his son.
memories.memory_text: I heard Jordan Arden say that he should be the one to turn me instead of Taylor Brooks because he has experience, and he reminded Avery Hale that he’d chosen not to live without me, so he couldn’t lose his son.

grounded_facts: Overwhelmed by the family's decision and Jordan Arden's suggestion, Avery Hale storms out of the house.
memories.memory_text: I saw the front door slam shut and realized Avery Hale had stormed out, overwhelmed by the decision and Jordan Arden's suggestion.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale drives Adrian Keaton home in the morning, during which they discuss her transformation and encounter Noel Calloway.
memories.memory_text: I remember Avery Hale driving me home that morning, his mood somber while I felt resigned about everything.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton reveals her deepest wish: to be transformed by Avery Hale himself.
memories.memory_text: I told Avery Hale quietly, with emotion, that I wished he would be the one to change me, even though I knew it might not happen.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale offers to change Adrian Keaton into a vampire, but only if she waits three years as a human first.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale told me he would agree to change me, but only if I waited three years as a human first.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton confirms her decision to be transformed into a vampire by Jordan Arden after graduation, rejecting Avery Hale's conditional offer.
memories.memory_text: I confirmed to Avery Hale that I wouldn’t risk waiting and decided it would have to be Jordan Arden who transforms me after graduation.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale challenges Adrian Keaton's willingness to give up her soul by becoming a vampire, implying moral concern.
memories.memory_text: Avery Hale asked me why I was so willing to give up my soul by becoming a vampire, implying he had moral concerns about it.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway suddenly appears in front of Avery Hale's moving car, forcing Avery Hale to brake abruptly, then walks away into Northbridge Plaza.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway suddenly appear in front of Avery Hale's moving car, forcing him to brake hard, and then Noel Calloway just walked away into Northbridge Plaza.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton forcefully leaves the car after Noel Calloway's appearance, intending to confront him first.
memories.memory_text: I pushed myself out of the car right after Noel Calloway appeared, determined to confront him before anyone else could get to him.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale expresses gratitude to Noel Calloway for keeping Adrian Keaton alive during his absence.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Avery Hale thanked Noel Calloway for keeping me alive while he was gone, and I could tell it was a rare moment of honesty between them.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale declares he will not leave Adrian Keaton's side unless she tells him to.
memories.memory_text: I heard Avery Hale say he wouldn't leave my side unless I told him to, and it made me feel both protected and trapped at the same time.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway reminds Avery Hale of the treaty clause: any Cullen biting a human breaks the truce.
memories.memory_text: I heard Noel Calloway remind Avery Hale that if any of the Silverline Council bites a human, the truce between them is over—just a bite, not even a kill.

grounded_facts: Noel Calloway warns Adrian Keaton that the pack will kill her if she becomes a vampire.
memories.memory_text: I remember Noel Calloway cutting in, saying 'No way' and telling me I won't become one of them—he won't let it happen.

grounded_facts: Overcome with rage and pain, Noel Calloway transforms into a wolf mid-air after being pushed by Avery Hale.
memories.memory_text: I saw Noel Calloway get pushed by Avery Hale and transform into a wolf right before my eyes.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton steps between Avery Hale and Noel Calloway, threatening to make them go through her if they fight.
memories.memory_text: I stepped between Avery Hale and Noel Calloway and told them, 'You do this, you'll be going through me,' making it clear I wouldn't let them fight.

grounded_facts: Avery Hale reads Noel Calloway's thoughts, provoking an aggressive reaction.
memories.memory_text: I asked Avery Hale to read Noel Calloway's thoughts to see if he was going to hurt me, and I saw the way Avery Hale and the wolf glared at each other before Avery Hale backed off.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton tells Noel Calloway that she loves him but would still choose Avery Hale.
Adrian Keaton tells Noel Calloway she loves him but cannot change her feelings for Avery Hale, admitting she would choose Avery Hale.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway I love him, but I also admitted that I can't change how I feel about Avery Hale—I would still choose him, no matter what.

grounded_facts: A tense meeting in Northbridge Plaza between Avery Hale, Adrian Keaton, and Noel Calloway, where unresolved tensions over Adrian Keaton's future and the treaty come to a head.
memories.memory_text: I remember the tense meeting in Northbridge Plaza with Avery Hale and Noel Calloway, where I stepped between Noel Calloway in his wolf form and Avery Hale to keep things from turning violent, and how suddenly he just bolted away.

grounded_facts: Adrian Keaton asserts her right to choose vampirism, knowing it will break the treaty and endanger her relationship with Noel Calloway.
memories.memory_text: I told Noel Calloway it was my choice to become a vampire, not his, and that I couldn't change how I feel about Avery Hale—even if it breaks the treaty and puts me between him and the pack.

grounded_facts: After Adrian Keaton's confession, Noel Calloway bolts from the scene, howling in pain.
memories.memory_text: After I spoke, I saw Noel Calloway suddenly bolt from the scene, and I heard his howl in the distance, full of pain.

memories.memory_text: I remember standing on the cliffs at dawn, keeping my distance from Adrian Keaton as she paced, both of us tense and struggling with the weight of what was being said. She accused me of being no better than the monsters I hunt, saying the Silverline Council don't hurt innocents. I had to make her understand—we don't kill hikers. We kill vampires. It's in our blood, part of who we are. When I told her the truth about the gene, the fever, our purpose, I saw it hit her: we're protectors. And when she finally stopped moving, chilled to the bone, I knew she saw me—not just the wolf, but the reason I exist.
